title: Real-time Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-qPCR)
author: Izabela M Rezende
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pw8dphw

steps.title: Calculate Reaction Requirements
steps.instruction: Determine the total number of reactions needed, ensuring each sample is tested in at least duplicate or triplicate.

substeps.instruction: Include negative controls from RNA extraction, non-template controls (NTC), and positive control reactions.
Add 1 or 2 additional reactions to compensate for pipetting error.

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (excluding the RNA template) for a final reaction volume of 20µl per sample.

substeps.instruction: Combine GoTaq® Probe qPCR Master Mix (formulated with dUTP), GoScript™ RT Mix for 1-Step RT-qPCR, primers, hydrolysis probe, and Nuclease-Free Water.

steps.title: Dispense Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of the prepared reaction mix (without RNA template) to each PCR tube or well of an optical grade PCR plate.

steps.title: Add RNA Template
steps.instruction: Add the RNA template to the appropriate wells; add water for the no-template control reactions.

steps.title: Seal and Prepare for Cycling
steps.instruction: Seal the tubes or optical plate and prepare them for the thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly to collect contents at the bottom of the wells.
Protect samples from extended light exposure or elevated temperatures before cycling.

steps.title: Perform Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the samples using the specified cycling parameters.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Analyze the results according to the manufacturer's instructions based on the following criteria:

substeps.instruction: Verify that RNA extraction controls and non-template controls are negative.
Verify that the positive control is positive.
A sample is considered positive if at least two replicates show amplification at or below a cycle threshold (Ct) of 37.
